instruction: Set the auto-save interval to 5 minutes in LibreOffice.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to change slide orientation from landscape to portrait. First tried the Properties panel dropdown, then navigated to Slide > Slide Properties dialog. Successfully selected Portrait radio button and clicked OK. Slide visually changed to portrait but evaluator returned score 0.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Impress menus, open Slide Properties dialog, change radio buttons and settings in dialogs, interact with Properties panel
metadata.failure_analysis: Model correctly performed the orientation change visually, but check_slide_orientation_Portrait returned 0. Possible issue with file save timing or format compatibility.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified settings task that exercises the model's demonstrated menu navigation and dialog interaction capabilities in a different LibreOffice settings context (Tools > Options).
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Tools > Options > Load/Save > General and changing the autosave interval to 5 minutes. Evaluator reads the LibreOffice config file (registrymodifications.xcu) and checks the AutoSaveTimeIntervall value matches 5 minutes. [Fixed: changed expected rules key from 'expected_minutes' to 'minutes' to match check_auto_saving_time function signature]
fix_history: Fix 1: Changed expected rules key from 'expected_minutes' to 'minutes' to match check_auto_saving_time function parameter (line 924 of slides.py)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads LibreOffice config file (registrymodifications.xcu) which stores auto-save settings.
Metric check_auto_saving_time correctly parses the XML, locates AutoSaveTimeIntervall under /org.openoffice.Office.Common/Save/Document, and compares the value to the expected 5 minutes.
Expected rules key 'minutes' matches what check_auto_saving_time accesses via rules['minutes'] (line 924). Previous key mismatch was already fixed.

Minor coverage gap: evaluator only checks the autosave time interval but does not verify that auto-save is actually enabled (AutoSaveEnabled property). The instruction 'Set the auto-save interval to 5 minutes' primarily targets the interval value, so this is a minor issue.
No postconfig needed since the getter reads a file on disk, not UI state.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optionally add a check that auto-save is enabled (AutoSaveEnabled property) in addition to the interval check, to ensure full verification of the instruction's intent.
